quotes.text: This changelog doesn’t apply to you if you’re on [Clover](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/clover.md) or later. Refer to the [Stripe changelog](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog.md) instead.
Before migrating to Clover, first [update your integration](https://docs.stripe.com/checkout/elements-with-checkout-sessions-api/changelog.md#migrating-to-basil) to Basil.
Update the API version to be at least `2025-09-30.clover` on your back-end integration.
The change creates the subscription after the user has completed the payment, so `checkout_session.invoice` and `checkout_session.subscription` are null until the Checkout Session completes.

old_evidence.text: If you’re already on the [Clover release](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/clover.md) of Elements with Checkout Sessions API, this changelog doesn’t apply to you.
Update the API version to be at least `2025-09-30.clover` on your back-end integration.

findings: The new changelog explicitly says it applies only to the beta migration history and is inapplicable to Clover or later, routing those integrations to the general Stripe changelog (new lines 9-11). The old notice named Clover alone (old lines 8-10). The existing source's 'Clover (Latest)' and 'stable Clover (latest)' wording at lines 13 and 20 needs a dated, non-current label; its line 18 warning already flags package-qualified Dahlia history.

Clover and Basil migration requirements and central breaking changes remain the same: beta-to-Basil-to-Clover sequence (new lines 25-39, 137-170; old lines 24-38, 131-160); synchronous initCheckout/loadActions, React checkout entrypoint and state union (new lines 17-23, 41-121; old lines 16-22, 40-115); deferred subscription/invoice association until completion under Basil (new lines 127-134; old lines 121-128).

The illustrative 'Before' API-version beta header changes from 2026-03-25.dahlia in the old capture (old line 172) to 2026-10-28.endive in the new capture (new line 182). The 'After' remains 2025-03-31.basil (new line 196; old line 186). This example refresh does not require beta users to adopt Endive or establish that historical initCheckout works on Endive.

Other diff changes are numbering, spacing, quote style, TypeScript code-fence labels, and link targets for quickstart/tax references (diff lines 14-116, 133-176). No new beta release entry or changed migration action appears in the capture.
substantive_changes: Scope notice now explicitly excludes Clover or later and points to the general Stripe changelog (new line 11 versus old line 10).
The illustrative pre-Basil beta API version was refreshed to 2026-10-28.endive from 2026-03-25.dahlia; it is an example value, not an added migration requirement (new line 182 versus old line 172).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain the dated beta-to-Basil-to-Clover sequence, package floors, and server API minimums from both captures (new lines 25-39, 137-170; old lines 24-38, 131-160).
Retain beta_6 and beta_5 changes as version-scoped history, including method renames, result schema, return URL and nested pricing changes (new lines 211-258; old lines 201-248).

Keep the existing source's warning that retained later package versions and runtime APIs require separate package-qualified evidence; this beta changelog is not a current integration guide for Clover or later (source lines 17-18; new line 11).
conflicts: The source calls Clover 'Latest' at lines 13 and 20, while the new raw explicitly excludes Clover or later at line 11 and the source's own line 18 warns about retained Dahlia-era package declarations. This is a dated label to revise, not evidence that the migration history is wrong.

The new 'Before' code sample uses an Endive beta header at line 182 in a historical migration section; the same page says this changelog is inapplicable to Clover or later at line 11. Treat the sample as illustrative copied syntax, not proof of an Endive beta integration path.
unresolved_questions: The page does not establish whether any given merchant still has beta entitlement or what live Stripe.js/runtime behavior is deployed; no account or browser execution is part of this comparison.
The Endive pre-migration code example at new line 182 is not accompanied by compatibility explanation, so its executable status and relationship to current package releases remain unverified.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/checkout/elements-with-checkout-sessions-api/changelog, [[source-stripe-checkout-elements-beta-changelog]] retains the same beta, Basil and Clover migration substance: compare old lines 16-38 and 121-160 with new lines 17-39 and 127-170. The November notice now excludes Clover or later, not just Clover (old line 10; new line 11), and its illustrative pre-Basil header changes from Dahlia to Endive (old line 172; new line 182). The code-fence, formatting and link edits do not create a new beta release.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/checkout/elements-with-checkout-sessions-api/changelog, [[source-stripe-checkout-elements-beta-changelog]] warrants a source_required_update to remove its unqualified 'Clover (Latest)' label and attach the new dated scope notice. New line 11 sends Clover-or-later readers to the general changelog, while old line 10 only names Clover. Preserve the historical migration steps and package floors at old lines 24-38 and new lines 25-39; do not turn the Endive 'Before' sample at new line 182 into a required or verified current integration.
